_comment: Agent-loop graph template: the Claude-Code-shaped degenerate graph —
no retrieval/rank pipeline, just memory + a response generator cycling
with TOOL_EXECUTOR until the model stops calling tools. All 'architecture'
(whether to search the knowledge base, how many search rounds, when to
answer) is decided by the model per turn via tools, not by graph topology.
Publish by creating these records through the admin panel / proxy server
(owner 'System' for the shared template, or a customerId for a tenant
copy). DDB stores `edges` and each node `config` as JSON STRINGS —
stringify the objects below when seeding; nodeIds must be regenerated
to real NOD… ids and referenced consistently from edges/entryPoint.
maxIterations is the generator↔tools loop budget. 40 (vs the pipeline
default 10) because an agent legitimately runs many rounds; LangGraph
aborts the run beyond it, which is the runaway backstop.
The tool_route edge is the loop's exit contract: 'builtin' loops through
the executor, 'caller' exits so caller-defined tool calls reach the API
caller, 'none' means the model answered — the natural agent exit.

graph.name: Agent
graph.description: Tool-driven agent loop: the model decides when to search its knowledge base or the web, iterates until done, then answers.
